name: Well Stocked
text:
Well Stocked:
If there are 2 or more Supply cubes in this city when
this card is drawn, do not remove any Supply cubes.

mechanics.trigger: When this card is drawn, if its city has 2 or more Supply cubes
mechanics.effect: Do not remove any Supply cubes.
restrictions: Only if the city has 2 or more Supply cubes when the card is drawn
